subject: Re: Interop + telemetry shim for ISV SDK integrations
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara@forgelane.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng-integration@forgelane.ai
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Partnership: lightweight telemetry shim for ISV SDKs

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the convo last week. Quick follow-up: ForgeLane is building a lightweight telemetry/interop shim designed to sit between ISV SDKs (LangChain, LlamaIndex, and a couple of prompt-tooling libs) and inference providers. Our goal is twofold: 1) standardize trace/context propagation so downstream observability (latency, token counts, model variant) is consistent across SDKs, and 2) add a tiny opt-in payload that lets platforms like Redwood make smarter routing/batching decisions without bundling vendor-specific hooks into every SDK.

We put a short draft spec together (attached: interop-spec-v1.md + telemetry-schema.json) and a 2-min prototype demo. Would Redwood be open to a short pilot: a joint shim that we co-maintain, plus a small integration test suite that validates trace headers and token accounting? In return, ForgeLane will prioritize Redwood as a recommended provider in our ISV marketplace and share usage telemetry for the pilot to help with batching strategies.

Proposed kickoff: 1) NDA (attached), 2) 4-week pilot (integration + validation tests), 3) post-pilot retro to define GA guardrails.

Curious if Marissa/Ben would want to join a kickoff next week to scope the testing matrix.

Best,
Sara
Partnerships, ForgeLane

Attachments:
- interop-spec-v1.md (text)
- telemetry-schema.json (text)
- forgelane-prototype-demo.mov (video stub)
- nda-signed.pdf (PDF stub)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@forgelane.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: lightweight telemetry shim for ISV SDKs

Sara — really appreciate the clear spec and demo. This aligns tightly with Redwood Optimize and our routing telemetry work. Quick answers: yes, we’re open to a pilot; NDA received and looks good.

Immediate asks from our side so we can scope the pilot: 
- A minimal acceptance checklist for the shim (what qualifies as "trace/context propagated" vs optional metadata).
- A suggested compatibility matrix: which SDK versions (LangChain, LlamaIndex, PromptFlow) you want to cover in the initial 4 weeks.
- Any hard constraints for payload size or latency (we care about <1ms added p99 ideally).

Marissa — can you lead the integration test plan? Ben — please advise on any partner referral terms we should promise in the marketplace listing. Laura — could you own the SRE side for the pilot SLA?

I can host a 30-min kickoff Thu 2/22 10am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Onboard checklist (brief): NDA OK, high-level spec read, pilot timeline requested.

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T14:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: lightweight telemetry shim for ISV SDKs

All — I dug into the spec. High-level plan for a 4-week pilot:

Week 0 (prep): align on SDK versions and target test harness (we should include LangChain v0.3.x, LlamaIndex v1.1.x, and PromptKit v0.9).
Week 1: implement Redwood-specific adapter in the shim + basic trace extraction tests (propagation across async calls, KV cache key tagging).
Week 2: integrate telemetry schema and emission to a staging observability endpoint; run token-count reconciliation against sample logs.
Week 3: resilience tests (latency under high concurrency, failure-mode fallbacks), finalize validation suite.
Week 4: demo + handoff doc + GA gating checklist (metrics, safety checks, perf budget).

Needed from ForgeLane: a small set of representative prompts and a pre-built smoke test harness (we can adapt your demo mov into a test vector). Also confirm the list of SDKs and minor versions.

I’ll draft the test matrix and share by EOD tomorrow. If Karthik schedules Thu 10am PT we’ll be ready.

—Marissa
Director, Developer Partnerships

Quoted: "On 2027-02-20 09:12, Sara Lin wrote: > ForgeLane is building a lightweight telemetry/interop shim..."

From: Sara Lin <sara@forgelane.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Ho <marcus.ho@forgelane.ai>, eng-integration@forgelane.ai
Date: 2027-02-21T08:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: lightweight telemetry shim for ISV SDKs

Marissa / team — great, thanks for the quick turn. Attached is a canonical test harness (zip stub referenced in Drive link) and the SDK compatibility list: LangChain 0.3.2, LangChain 0.3.5, LlamaIndex 1.1.0, PromptKit 0.9.1. We can trim if you prefer a narrower initial scope.

One clarifying note: ForgeLane plans to include an optional sample payload called "rlu_meta" (routing/latency hints) that is always opt-in and recommended only for pilot partners. We’ve kept that payload <200 bytes and provide an allowlist for fields.

We’ve also pre-signed the NDA and uploaded to DocuSign (link below). Looking forward to Thu.

Sara

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@forgelane.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-22T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: lightweight telemetry shim for ISV SDKs — kickoff notes + action items

Team / Sara — great kickoff today. Summary + action items (owner -> due):

1) Test matrix (Marissa) -> share GitHub test plan and initial cases by 2027-02-24 EOD.
2) Shim acceptance checklist + perf budget (Laura) -> draft by 2027-02-24 EOD. Key constraint: shim must not add >1ms median and <5ms p99 to token pipeline at our staging QPS.
3) Marketplace listing draft (Ben) -> initial partner entry for ForgeLane with co-brand language by 2027-03-03.
4) Instrumentation endpoint (Karthik) -> provide staging telemetry endpoint and API key for ForgeLane engineering by 2027-02-23.
5) ForgeLane: provide smoke harness and sample prompts (Sara) -> by 2027-02-22 EOD (received).

We also agreed on success criteria for the pilot: consistent token-count reconciliation (<2% delta), correct trace/span context for request chains across SDK versions, and zero silent failures when shim is present (clear failure pathways).

I’ll open a shared repo and add the draft acceptance checklist. Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving.

Karthik
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
